themes.description: Users report that the application fails to launch, crashes, or does not install on devices, often after updates, causing frustration and inability to use core functionality.
themes.business_impact: Loss of daily active users, churn in premium subscription, negative word‑of‑mouth, increased support tickets, and potential revenue loss from subscription cancellations.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Recent updates introduced incompatibilities with newer Android OS versions and permission changes, causing runtime crashes or installation failures.
themes.action_plan:
• Investigate crash logs and perform regression testing on recent update
• Add compatibility check for Android versions and prompt for upgrade or downgrade
• Fix installation flow to handle device storage constraints and permission prompts
• Implement graceful fallback for crash on launch using try/catch and error screens
• Deploy hotfix with clear changelog and monitor crash metrics
• Communicate to users with support resources and temporary workarounds

themes.name: [Negative] Excessive and Hidden Charges

quotes.text: Charges are very High.,Please work on it

themes.description: Customers consistently report that the platform charges high fees for transactions, often citing hidden or unclear charges that increase the cost of trading beyond what they anticipated.
themes.business_impact: The perceived costliness directly drives users to consider alternative platforms, leading to increased churn, reduced trade volume, and a negative impact on revenue per active user.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The fee structure likely includes higher brokerage rates, undisclosed service charges, and potentially inflated tax components, compounded by a lack of transparency in the fee disclosure process.
themes.action_plan:
• Audit the current fee schedule and compare it with industry benchmarks
• Identify all hidden or implicit charges and eliminate or disclose them upfront
• Negotiate lower brokerage rates with service partners
• Update the UI to present a clear, itemized fee breakdown at every trade step
• Communicate fee changes through in-app notifications and email, emphasizing the new transparency and savings
• Monitor user feedback and trade volume post-implementation for continuous improvement
